Game Overview

In Flipxy - The Bat, the core idea is straightforward: guide a restless bat through a thrilling arcade adventure, flipping directions with precision. Collect coins, dodge spooky foes, and grab energy-boosting bananas. Defeat haunting bosses and revel in the eerie Halloween atmosphere, making each flip a pulse-pounding moment of survival.
